tools.name: floss_list
tools.description: The floss to buy for a Gridstitch sampler or motif, as plain text: each DMC number and color name, how many stitches use it, and how many skeins, for the fabric count and strands given. Pass motif for a library motif, or text (and the other sampler choices) for a word sampler.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: List what Gridstitch can chart: every library motif with its size and pack, the stitch alphabets, the borders, the color sets and the fabric counts, and which are free.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: With a code, says what it opens (Pro, which packs). With no code, says what Pro and the packs add, what they cost and where to get them. Nothing is bought through this tool.
